Committee: Judiciary
Sponsor: Allen
Analyst: Robin Rawls
Date: 01/11/2021
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 1 as introduced could increase receipts to the State General Fund and municipal general funds from fines; increase receipts to the State General Fund, county general funds, and other funds to which court costs are deposited; and could increase the obligations of the State General Fund, the district attorneys, the Department of Corrections, community corrections programs, and the Bureau of Pardons and Paroles by an undetermined amount dependent upon the number of persons charged with and convicted of the offenses provided by this bill and the penalties imposed.
Additionally, this bill could decrease the obligations of Alabama's Medicaid Program by an undetermined amount dependent on (1) the number of minors who would have otherwise been provided treatments or services prohibited in the bill and (2) the cost to the Program for these treatments or services.
